title: Riverside Allotments: Storm recovery
titleZh: 河畔社區菜園：風災復原
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 | Garden committee notice
The west gate and the lane immediately inside it are closed while the fence posts are reset. Members may use the north gate to move tools or compost, provided they keep the yellow strip clear. The strip is the fire crew's route to the pump shed.

Visitors must enter with the member they are visiting. The nearby footbridge is not a garden entrance, and the committee cannot issue keys to the gate at its far end.

If a raised bed is too wet to use, its holder may borrow a spare planter once the plot steward has initialled the plot number on the damage board. An initialled entry shows the bed has been inspected; it does not mean a planter has been assigned.

At the next work party, use the clean boards stacked under the shelter. Leave the grey boards alone; they came from the damaged fence and may still contain nails.

If a damaged fixture cannot be put back into service, photograph both the fixture and the tag fixed to it. A square tag identifies committee property: the treasurer needs the photos before approving a replacement. A round tag identifies a fixture lent by the housing association: send the photos to its caretaker, even if the fixture stands inside our fence.

DOCUMENT 2 | Text messages
Ruth: I left the bag of compost outside the north gate. The wheelbarrow sank as soon as I turned off the paved path near my plot.

Ivo: The mat from the tool shed will get a loaded barrow across that soft patch. It tears on an edge, though, so don't drag it over the kerb on the yellow strip.

Ruth: I'll lay it where the paved path meets the grass, just past the water tank. Mara from next door offered to help shift the bag, but she can only come before I get back from my appointment.

Ivo: I can meet Mara at the north gate. She was coming anyway to return the secateurs I lent her.

Ruth: Let's just leave the bag where it is until I get back. If you see Kit, can you ask what the pencil ring beside number 18 means? That's my plot, and my bed's still too wet to plant in.

Ivo: Before I forget, the water-tank stand and the outside tap assembly both tipped over. I took pictures of each with its tag. The stand is back in place, and we filled two cans from the tap after I straightened it. But the crank in the hose reel sheared off; there’s no way to wind it up now.

DOCUMENT 3 | Email from Kit to Ivo and Ruth: Damage board and other notes
A ring in pencil means someone asked me to have a look. I visited the lower beds first. Beside 18 I wrote KJ in ink over the pencil ring; it may not show in the picture someone sent round. I left the rings beside 14 and 21 as they were.

I moved the spare planters from the shelter to the pump shed before the storm so they wouldn't blow loose. The new names on the shelter hooks are for people borrowing tools, not planters.

The water tank is beyond the pump shed turn-off. Only the short lane between the north gate and that turn-off has been marked in yellow. If the fence team needs fasteners, there is a sealed box on the tool-shed shelf marked ‘fence’.

The gate at the far end of the footbridge belongs to the neighbouring housing association. They asked us not to redirect anyone across the bridge even to collect items from outside our fence.

The loose square tag by the hose reel came off the water-tank stand when it tipped. The reel still has its own tag on the back; it’s the same shape as the tag on the outside tap assembly. The tap’s tag is round, and the assembly appears on the association’s loan list.
passageZh:
文件 1｜菜園委員會公告
西門及門內緊鄰的小路在重新固定圍欄柱期間暫停使用。會員可從北門搬運工具或堆肥，但必須保持黃色標線區暢通。那是消防人員前往抽水機房的通道。

來訪者必須與受訪會員一起入園。附近的人行橋不是菜園入口，委員會也無法發放橋另一端閘門的鑰匙。

如果高架種植床太濕而無法使用，地塊管理員在受損公告板的地塊編號旁簽上姓名縮寫後，使用人就可以借用備用花槽。簽上縮寫表示種植床已檢查，並不表示已分配花槽。

下次集體整修時，請用棚下堆放的乾淨木板。不要用灰色木板；那些是從受損圍欄拆下的，裡面可能還有釘子。

受損設備若無法恢復使用，請拍下設備本身及其固定標牌。方形牌代表委員會的財產：財務負責人必須先看到照片，才能核准更換。圓形牌代表住宅協會借給菜園的設備：即使設備位於菜園圍欄內，也要把照片寄給住宅協會的管理員。

文件 2｜手機訊息
露絲：我把那袋堆肥放在北門外。獨輪手推車一離開我地塊附近的鋪面步道就陷下去了。

伊沃：工具房的墊子能讓載重的獨輪手推車通過那片軟地。不過墊子碰到硬邊會破，不要拖過黃線區的路緣。

露絲：我會把墊子鋪在水箱過去一點、鋪面步道接到草地的地方。隔壁的瑪拉說可以幫我搬那袋堆肥，但她只有在我赴約回來前有空。

伊沃：我可以去北門接瑪拉。她本來就要來還我借給她的修枝剪。

露絲：那袋堆肥先放原處，等我回來再搬吧。你要是看到基特，能不能問一下 18 號旁邊的鉛筆圈是什麼意思？那是我的地塊，種植床還是太濕，不能種東西。

伊沃：趁我還沒忘記，水箱支架和戶外水龍頭組都倒了。我已各自拍下設備和標牌。支架已放回原位，我把水龍頭扶正後也用它裝滿了兩個澆水壺。不過水管捲盤的搖柄斷了，現在完全收不了水管。

文件 3｜基特寄給伊沃及露絲的電子郵件：受損公告板及其他事項
鉛筆圈表示有人請我去看看。我先檢查地勢較低的種植床。我在 18 號旁的鉛筆圈上用墨水寫了 KJ；大家傳看的那張照片可能看不出來。14 號和 21 號旁的圈我沒有改動。

風災前我把備用花槽從棚下搬到抽水機房，以免被強風吹走。棚下掛鉤新增的名字是登記借工具的人，不是借花槽的人。

水箱在通往抽水機房的岔口之後。只有北門到那個岔口之間的短路段畫了黃線。圍欄整修小組如果需要固定零件，工具房架上有一盒封好的，標著「圍欄」。

人行橋另一端的閘門屬於鄰近的住宅協會。他們請我們不要引導任何人改走那座橋，就算只是去拿放在我們圍欄外的物品也一樣。

水管捲盤旁那塊掉在地上的方形牌，是水箱支架倒下時掉下來的。捲盤背面的原有標牌還在，形狀和戶外水龍頭組的標牌一樣。水龍頭的標牌是圓形的，這組水龍頭也列在住宅協會的出借清單上。
